commitMessage:
Bug 130922: [quick assist] 'Assign parameter to new field' must not make
field final'
dslRule:
<!id: field.visibility.private.to.public.editor.save.participant>
<!description: Changes the visibility of the specific static final field 'EDITOR_SAVE_PARTICIPANT_PREFIX' from private to public.>
<!severity: INFO>

private static final $Type $fieldName = $init; :: matchesAny($fieldName, "EDITOR_SAVE_PARTICIPANT_PREFIX")
=>
public static final $Type $fieldName = $init;
;;
summary: Changes 'private static final' to 'public static final' for a field named 'EDITOR_SAVE_PARTICIPANT_PREFIX'.

commitMessage: Bug 366014: Make it easier to setup null analysis
dslRule:
<!id: jface.document.getLineOffset.fix>
<!description: Fix incorrect usage of IDocument.getLineOffset by providing a line number instead of an offset.>
<!severity: ERROR>

$document.getLineOffset($match.getOffset())
:: instanceof($document, "org.eclipse.jface.text.IDocument") && instanceof($match, "org.eclipse.jface.text.IRegion")
=>
$document.getLineOffset($document.getLineOfOffset($match.getOffset()))
;;
summary: Corrects the misuse of `IDocument.getLineOffset` by ensuring a line number (obtained via `getLineOfOffset`) is passed instead of a raw offset.

commitMessage: Bug 181788: [quick fix] Quick fix to import static from favorite class
dslRule:
<!id: simplify.static.method.fqn>
<!description: Replace fully qualified static method invocation with a simple name, adding static import.
This cleanup improves code readability and conciseness by replacing 'FQCN.method()' with 'method()'.>
<!severity: HINT>
<!tags: static-import, style, readability, java-8>

$type.$methodName($args$) :: isStatic($methodName)
=>
$methodName($args$)
;;
summary: Simplifies fully qualified static method calls to their simple names by adding static imports.

commitMessage: Bug 383110: [quick assist] Issues in "Convert 'if-else' to 'switch'" on String, Enum, and boxed types
dslRule:
<!id: java.lang.String.equals.nullsafe>
<!description: Replace potentially null-unsafe `variable.equals(literal)` with null-safe `literal.equals(variable)` for String comparisons when the variable may be null.>
<!severity: HINT>

$var.equals($literal) :: instanceof($var, "java.lang.String") && isStringLiteral($literal) && isNullable($var)
=>
$literal.equals($var)
;;
summary: Replaces `variable.equals("literal")` with `"literal".equals(variable)` for String comparisons when `variable` may be null, to prevent NullPointerExceptions.
